title: Immunonutrition vs EPA-DHA Enriched Nutritional Support in Patients With Cancer Undergoing Surgery
official: IMMUNONUTRITION VS EPA-DHA ENRICHED NUTRITIONAL SUPPORT IN PATIENTS WITH CANCER UNDERGOING SURGERY
summary: To compare clinical and molecular effects of nutritional support (immunonutrition or EPA-DHA enriched oral nutritional supplements) in patients with cancer undergoing surgery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cancer undergoing surgery (primary tumor location; gastrointestinal tract, ovarian, peritoneal carcinomatosis)

Exclusion Criteria:

* End-stage liver disease
* End-stage kidney disease
sponsor: Maimónides Biomedical Research Institute of Córdoba
